info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Create Loyalty Loyalty Earn-v1-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Earn API facilitates the bulk processing of loyalty points for customers within a loyalty program. By leveraging this API, businesses can efficiently record and manage the accrual of loyalty points, enhancing customer engagement and satisfaction. Typical consumers of this API include loyalty program managers and e-commerce platforms looking to incentivize customer purchases. The API supports batch insertions, allowing for high-volume transactions to streamline loyalty point management.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to earn loyalty points by performing designated actions. It captures the necessary data required to calculate and credit the points to the user's account based on their activities.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a transaction for earning loyalty points. Ensure that all required fields are included as per the defined schema.
